note: Shape only (issue 54, ADR 0137). Nothing here is a provisioned host or image. This restates, for an ARM64 CI tools image or future ARM64 host, the deployment requirements docs/worker-isolation.md section 8 already states for Linux (x86_64 or aarch64). It does not change crates/custodian-worker, and nothing parses or enforces this file.
runner_label: ubuntu-24.04-arm (GitHub-hosted; availability on this repository's current plan is unconfirmed until a probe workflow actually runs)

required_packages.name: util-linux
required_packages.note: same inner path used by BubblewrapSandbox::build_argv; must exist inside the mounted system roots, not only on the host

forbidden_on_image: protected corpus or any sealed population data
production signing, ledger, App, or database-admin credentials
operational environment variables (see crate's ENV_ALLOWLIST / DENY_FRAGMENTS)
a container runtime socket or host PID namespace exposed to the worker account

worker_account.note: open risk: supplementary-group dropping is not independently probed by run_self_check today (ADR 0137 privilege-drop step 7)

per_dispatch_privilege_and_mount_contrac.capabilities: --cap-drop ALL, applied before any mount or exec
per_dispatch_privilege_and_mount_contrac.environment: --clearenv, then only the fixed ENV_ALLOWLIST names set via --setenv; credential-shaped names refused even if added to the allowlist
per_dispatch_privilege_and_mount_contrac.filesystem_root: fresh tmpfs, system roots (/usr, /lib*, /bin, /sbin) bound read-only, then --remount-ro / after every mount is in place
per_dispatch_privilege_and_mount_contrac.proc_visibility: --proc /proc, a fresh procfs for the new PID namespace; self-check requires at most 8 visible processes

scratch.size_bytes_source: SandboxSpec.quotas.storage_bytes (from the approved plan, capped by OperatorCaps)

per_dispatch_privilege_and_mount_contrac.read_only_mounts: every SandboxSpec.ro_mounts entry (staged engine/adapter/scanner/candidate/config, staged inputs) bound with --ro-bind before the final remount
per_dispatch_privilege_and_mount_contrac.runner_state_visibility: none: control-plane SQLite connection, staging-base parent directory, signer socket, and ledger clone are never bind-mounted or reachable from inside the sandbox
per_dispatch_privilege_and_mount_contrac.inherited_descriptors: stdin=/dev/null, stdout and stderr explicitly redirected and bounded by the supervisor; the launcher passes no other open file descriptor (Rust marks its own fds close-on-exec by default)
per_dispatch_privilege_and_mount_contrac.result_channel: stdout only, min(plan limit, 64 KiB) bound with a one-byte-over kill; stderr counted and discarded, never retained
per_dispatch_privilege_and_mount_contrac.resource_limits_applied_by: prlimit, run inside the already-restricted namespaces, before exec of the pinned target: RLIMIT_CPU, RLIMIT_AS, RLIMIT_NPROC, RLIMIT_FSIZE, core dumps disabled, open-file cap
per_dispatch_privilege_and_mount_contrac.process_tree_cleanup: PID namespace death plus --die-with-parent, and the supervisor kills the child's own process group (process_group(0)) and reaps on every exit path

refusal_not_fallback.sandbox_unavailable_or_detect_failed: no dispatcher is built; no candidate ever runs outside the boundary
refusal_not_fallback.self_check_failed_or_incomplete: Dispatcher::new refuses without a Verified IsolationVerification covering every required check, in order
refusal_not_fallback.verification_stale: Dispatcher refuses a verification older than verification_max_age_secs
refusal_not_fallback.product_behavior_on_any_of_the_above: custodian-daemon::runtime::build_worker returns (None, reason); approved runs answer worker_unavailable; nothing executes unsandboxed

probes: /proc/sys/kernel/seccomp/actions_avail (kernel seccomp support; this repository installs no seccomp filter)
ci_capability_probe_only.untested_means: the tool or file was absent on this runner; this is not a passing or failing denial
does_not: launch any evaluation engine, adapter, scanner, or candidate
